card.name: Bossa Nova
card.tagline: Rio's samba-jazz fusion - a music genre, not a dance.
card.profile: Bossa nova is a Brazilian music genre that evolved in Rio de Janeiro in the late 1950s from a union of samba and cool jazz, associated with Joao Gilberto and Antonio Carlos (Tom) Jobim. Per English Wikipedia, unlike samba it has no dance steps to accompany it and did not become dance music; it is primarily a listening/song form (e.g. 'Garota de Ipanema'). Britannica defines it as music evolving from samba and cool jazz.
card.insight: Despite frequent listing among 'Brazilian dances,' bossa nova has no established choreography; Britannica defines it as a music genre evolving from samba and cool jazz.
